text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Neither Narita Taishin nor Winning Ticket 
were able to claim the glorious crown of 
the "Japanese Derby".

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Narita Taishin found it dazzling 
how Winning Ticket looked straight ahead 
toward the next stage, even with her 
dreams shattered.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next time for sure—in order to claim 
victory in the final leg of the Triple 
Crown, the Kikuka Sho, she vowed to build 
up her strength once more.
